description.zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the end time is the current query time.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看您当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of your WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不设置该参数，表示显示全部规则。

- **blacklist**: 表示命中IP黑名单。

- **custom**：表示命中自定义规则。

- **antiscan**: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

- **cc_system**:  表示命中CC防护规则。

- **region_block**: 表示区域封禁。
description.en:
The type of protection rule hit by the protected object. By default, this parameter is not specified, which indicates that all rules are displayed.

- **blacklist**: IP blacklist.

- **custom**: Custom rule.

- **antiscan**: Scan protection rule.

- **cc_system**: HTTP flood mitigation rule.

- **region_block**: Location blacklist.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds.

title.zh: 查看命中防护规则的Top 10 URL
title.en: Query top 10 uRLs with protection rule hits

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-hits-top-url --start-timestamp 1665331200 --end-timestamp 1665386280 --resource www.aliyundoc.com --rule-type blacklist --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeRuleHitsTopUrl --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --StartTimestamp 1665331200 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --Resource 'www.aliyundoc.com' --EndTimestamp 1665386280 --RuleType blacklist --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
